note: He passes the two physical criteria comfortably and fails all three commercial and situational ones. Not deconditioned is unambiguous — he is a working fitness instructor who coaches Pilates and metabolic training most evenings and puts himself in the top 10% for activity, and the goal is refinement from 184 lb back to 165-170 lb rather than rescue, so good-to-great holds too. But he is not the successful business owner or physician the ICP describes; he works a warehouse shift from seven to four and teaches classes in the evenings. On income the miss is as complete as it gets in this corpus: active Chapter 7 bankruptcy proceedings, no usable credit line, $600 cash, and roughly $6,000 of monthly obligations against roughly $6,200 of income. And health is not his neglected domain — it is his profession, which is the same inversion seen with Roy Norman on the same day. This is the clearest case yet that the stated ICP is not functioning as a screen: nothing in the criteria as written stops a prospect in insolvency from reaching a closing call, and nothing in the process required the rep to stop once he got there.
